title: I Quit
text:
When I first received this subscription I loved it however Ive stopped and restarted the box in the last couple months because its just no longer the same quality as it was. I can’t justify spending $50 for it when there are other boxes that have higher quality products for less of a cost.

So Im finally quitting. I might pick up some of the products every so often but I realized I have too many of FaceTory items that are never going to be suitable for my skin that were a total waste of money, no mater how much of a deal they were, they just aren’t products that work great.
label: negative
